newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose sharply to 1.428 billion yuan from 694 million on Thursday with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said trading was more active today with state banks participating in trading for the first time since the lunar new year holiday.
Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were net lenders today.
Traders said trading would be back to normal from next Monday with other financial markets including the stock markets reopening, pushing demand on the interbank market back up.
Beijing's recent ban on state banks trading on the state debt secondary markets will pump funds into the interbank market, depressing the rates in the short term, they said.
